description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Gauntlet Task Force (WP-M2a). Fixture sm11e_m2a_marines_active (the Captain in Phobos Armour with DAMOCLES-CLASS UPLINK is embarked in the Rhino). (1) Movement phase: the phase_start window shows the free DAMOCLES-CLASS UPLINK card with one button per (INFANTRY unit within 6" of the Rhino, doctrine); a REAL click on 'Intercessor Squad: Assault Doctrine' makes the assault doctrine active for the Intercessors (per-unit doctrine). (2) Shooting phase (P2 at 0 CP): the Impulsor (TRANSPORT) shoots the Deff Dread; the unit_has_shot window shows the free COMBINED DEPLOYMENT card; a REAL click on Use + a REAL click on the Deff Dread in the picker: it is assailed until the end of the turn, and an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn gets [SUSTAINED HITS 1] against it.
